safe_abstention_rule: Abstain on canonical-home selection when no unique primary exists.
sql_text: SELECT route_id,card_id,route_role,is_primary,route_status,intentional_unrouted_reason FROM canonical_route WHERE object_type=:object_type AND object_id=:object_id AND active=1 ORDER BY is_primary DESC,card_id,route_id

safe_abstention_rule: Abstain unless exactly one row is returned.
sql_text: SELECT card_id FROM canonical_route WHERE object_type=:object_type AND object_id=:object_id AND active=1 AND is_primary=1

safe_abstention_rule: No citation claim without returned evidence rows.
sql_text: SELECT * FROM v_assertion_evidence_chain WHERE assertion_id=:assertion_id ORDER BY evidence_relationship,evidence_id

safe_abstention_rule: Do not cite a source not returned by this query.
sql_text: SELECT DISTINCT s.source_id,s.source_name,s.source_date,s.authority_rank,s.source_posture,e.locator_kind,e.locator_value FROM v_assertion_evidence_chain e JOIN source s ON s.source_id=e.source_id WHERE e.assertion_id=:assertion_id ORDER BY s.authority_rank,s.source_id,e.evidence_id

safe_abstention_rule: Abstain when more than one entity_id or ambiguity_state=ambiguous.
sql_text: SELECT ca.entity_id,n.node_type,n.canonical_name,ca.ambiguity_state,ca.confidence_score FROM canonical_alias ca JOIN node n ON n.node_id=ca.entity_id WHERE ca.active=1 AND n.active=1 AND ca.normalized_alias=:normalized_alias ORDER BY ca.confidence_score DESC,ca.entity_id

safe_abstention_rule: Return no-answer when no approved current searchable document matches.
sql_text: SELECT sd.object_type,sd.object_id,sd.title,bm25(search_fts) AS score FROM search_fts JOIN search_document sd ON sd.search_rowid=search_fts.rowid WHERE search_fts MATCH :query AND sd.retrieval_eligible=1 AND sd.currentness_state='current' ORDER BY score,sd.object_type,sd.object_id LIMIT :limit

intent: Exact entity lookup by normalized canonical name
safe_abstention_rule: Return no-answer when zero rows; disambiguate when multiple rows.
sql_text: SELECT node_id,node_type,canonical_name,display_name,description FROM node WHERE active=1 AND lower(canonical_name)=lower(:name) ORDER BY node_id

safe_abstention_rule: Do not infer a resolution from an open validation.
sql_text: SELECT * FROM validation_queue WHERE status='open' AND (:priority IS NULL OR priority=:priority) ORDER BY CASE priority WHEN 'P0' THEN 0 WHEN 'P1' THEN 1 WHEN 'P2' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,due_date,validation_id

safe_abstention_rule: Preserve missing/unknown evidence; do not synthesize closure.
sql_text: SELECT validation_id,priority,owner,due_date,status,validation_question FROM validation_queue WHERE status='open' ORDER BY CASE priority WHEN 'P0' THEN 0 WHEN 'P1' THEN 1 WHEN 'P2' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,due_date,validation_id

safe_abstention_rule: Enforce maximum depth and cycle detection.
sql_text: WITH RECURSIVE walk(depth,start_id,current_id,path) AS (SELECT 0,:node_id,:node_id,'|'||:node_id||'|' UNION ALL SELECT w.depth+1,w.start_id,CASE WHEN e.from_node_id=w.current_id THEN e.to_node_id ELSE e.from_node_id END,w.path||CASE WHEN e.from_node_id=w.current_id THEN e.to_node_id ELSE e.from_node_id END||'|' FROM walk w JOIN v_canonical_edge e ON e.from_node_id=w.current_id OR e.to_node_id=w.current_id WHERE w.depth<2 AND instr(w.path,'|'||CASE WHEN e.from_node_id=w.current_id THEN e.to_node_id ELSE e.from_node_id END||'|')=0) SELECT DISTINCT depth,current_id,path FROM walk WHERE depth>0 ORDER BY depth,current_id,path
SELECT * FROM v_canonical_edge WHERE from_node_id=:node_id OR to_node_id=:node_id ORDER BY relationship_family,edge_type,from_node_id,to_node_id

safe_abstention_rule: Abstain on a single definitive answer while material conflict remains unresolved.
sql_text: SELECT * FROM v_conflicting_assertions WHERE subject_node_id=:subject_node_id ORDER BY predicate,assertion_id_1,assertion_id_2

safe_abstention_rule: Exclude rejected, superseded, expired, future-effective, and noncanonical rows.
sql_text: SELECT * FROM v_canonical_edge WHERE from_node_id=:from_node_id AND (:predicate IS NULL OR relationship_family=:predicate OR edge_type=:predicate) ORDER BY relationship_family,edge_type,to_node_id,assertion_id

safe_abstention_rule: Label legacy claim assertions as candidates, not confirmed facts.
sql_text: SELECT a.*,s.source_name,s.source_date,s.source_posture FROM v_current_assertion a JOIN source s ON s.source_id=a.primary_source_id WHERE a.legacy_record_type='claim' AND a.subject_node_id=:subject_node_id ORDER BY a.confidence_score DESC,a.assertion_id

safe_abstention_rule: Return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when eligible_count=0; return CONFLICT when material competing assertions exist.
sql_text: SELECT COUNT(*) AS eligible_count FROM v_current_assertion WHERE subject_node_id=:subject_node_id AND predicate=:predicate AND canonical_status='canonical' AND validation_state NOT IN ('rejected','needs_review')

safe_abstention_rule: Return no-answer when organization or relationship is absent.
sql_text: SELECT s.node_id,s.canonical_name,e.edge_type,e.valid_from,e.valid_to FROM v_canonical_edge e JOIN node s ON s.node_id=e.from_node_id JOIN node o ON o.node_id=e.to_node_id WHERE e.relationship_family='AFFILIATED_WITH' AND lower(o.canonical_name)=lower(:organization) ORDER BY s.canonical_name

intent: People connected through a role predicate
safe_abstention_rule: Return insufficient evidence when no evidence-backed current assertion exists.
sql_text: SELECT s.node_id,s.canonical_name,e.edge_type,o.node_id AS object_id,o.canonical_name AS object_name,e.valid_from,e.valid_to FROM v_canonical_edge e JOIN node s ON s.node_id=e.from_node_id JOIN node o ON o.node_id=e.to_node_id WHERE s.node_type IN ('person','stakeholder') AND e.relationship_family='HAS_ROLE_IN' AND lower(o.canonical_name) LIKE lower(:object_pattern) ORDER BY s.canonical_name,e.edge_type

safe_abstention_rule: Do not label a historical row as current.
sql_text: SELECT assertion_id,subject_node_id,predicate,legacy_predicate,object_node_id,valid_from,valid_to,recorded_at,superseded_at FROM v_historical_assertion WHERE subject_node_id=:subject_node_id ORDER BY coalesce(valid_from,''),recorded_at,assertion_id
